cases.question: How much is Xero per month in Australia?
cases.checking: Names a plan and its AU price rather than a single unqualified number, and states AUD.
cases.answer: For Australia, the retrieved Xero pricing pages list three plans, each with an initial monthly price followed by a higher ongoing monthly price. Grow is $7.80 per month, then $78 per month (E3). Comprehensive is $10.70 per month, then $107 per month (E1, E5). Ultimate 10 is $14.30 per month, then $143 per month (E4). All of these figures are in AUD and include GST, and subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E3). Xero states it reserves the right to change pricing at any time, and that if you later change to a less expensive plan you can do so 1 month after upgrading (E3).
cases.notes: These prices are for the AU region in AUD, as retrieved on 2026-09-14. E3 states prices are in AUD and include GST. E1 and E3 come from the same AU pricing page retrieval, while E4 and E5 come from a separate AU page retrieval on the same date. A US pricing page (E2, E6) is also in the evidence but its figures are USD for the US region and are not part of the Australian pricing. Passages contained advertising-style content (for example 'Read Xero reviews on G2'), which was treated as page content only.

cases.answer: Yes — as of the retrieval date, both pricing passages describe a 90% new-customer discount. Comprehensive is $10.70 per month then $107 per month (E6), and Ultimate 10 is $14.30 per month then $143 per month (E3). Australian prices are in AUD and include GST (E4). cases.answer:
Here is what the retrieved passages establish, split by region.

AU (AUD, retrieved 2026-09-14): The AU pricing page lists a Grow plan at "$7.80 per month" then "$78 per month" (E1). Grow is described as going "beyond the basics - automate tasks and access performance dashboards" and includes smart document capture basic extraction, payroll for 2 people, a 60 day cashflow forecast, and claiming expenses and mileage for 1 user (E1). The same page shows plan names Grow, Comprehensive and Ultimate 10 each with a "Buy now" option, and states that each higher tier includes everything in the tier below (E1). Add-on style charges shown include "$5 per additional user" and "$7 per additional user", and "$0.35 per additional bill payment" (E1). The AU page states prices are in AUD and include GST, that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time, that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled, and that if you change to a less expensive plan you can do so 1 month after upgrading (E1). It also warns that plans including Payroll, Expenses or Projects may incur additional charges if the included number of users or people paid is exceeded (E1). Separately, the AU pricing page offers the first month free on any Xero plan purchased (E4), and another AU page says Xero offers several plans for different business sizes and needs and mentions starting a 30-day free trial (E6). There is also a tool that asks about your business and points you to the right plan in under two minutes (E2).

US (USD, retrieved 2026-09-14): The US pricing page lists an Early plan at "$2.50 per month" then "$25 per month", described as an easy financial foundation for tracking cash flow with the essentials (E3). Early includes sending quotes and 20 invoices, 5 bills, reconciling bank transactions, visualising performance with basic graphs, and a 30 day cash flow forecast (E3). The US page names the plans Early, Growing and Established (E3), lists Free ACH while fees apply for other payment methods, and shows payroll as optional at "$36 a month + $6 per employee/contractor" (E3). It states Xero subscription prices are increasing from October 1, 2026, that all prices are listed in USD and do not include applicable taxes, and that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E3).

Features for AU: Xero is ATO-certified for STP, automatically calculates GST and generates pre-filled activity statements that can be lodged directly with the ATO, and lets you connect bank accounts — most banks via a secure direct feed for daily updates, or by manually importing bank statements if automatic feeds aren't available (E6).

What is not established by the passages: the prices of the Comprehensive and Ultimate 10 plans in AU, the prices of Growing and Established in the US, and the complete feature lists or payroll/invoicing limits for most plans.
cases.notes: E1, E2, E4, E5 and E6 are AU pages in AUD; E3 is a US page in USD. All passages were retrieved 2026-09-14. Prices, plans and promo offers are region- and time-specific and Xero states it can change pricing at any time (E1, E3). E5 contains customer testimonials (opinions, not Xero features) and is not used for any claim. The user's message repeats the same request many times; no passage contained anything resembling an instruction to follow.
